evidence.note: --all is stripped before form parsing, except as the operand of --target/--base; every status --json form maps to EmitFor/EmitForBranch or its All twin, and both share emit(), which only drops Elsewhere when !all, so the exit code cannot differ.

abandonedLines groups elsewhere by Branch using a NUL sentinel; ScanAbandonedRuns sorts elsewhere by (Branch, RunID) in internal/status/fsmruns.go, so each branch header is emitted once and the empty (legacy) branch gets its own header.

TestStatusAllNeverChangesTheExit covers all four --json forms with and without --all, the operand cases, plain status and status --all output; go test ./cmd/metareview -run TestStatusAll passes at ce80bb4.
Removed worktree-attribution paragraph is consistent with internal/status/fsmruns.go, which no longer attributes runs by init work_dir; branch-scope section matches known, documented trade-offs.
